**Design doc**: .design/llm-moderation-assist.md
**Implements**: REQ-J1; AC-10

**Files to add**:
- polaris-frontend/src/components/llm_recommendation_panel.rs
- polaris-frontend/styles/llm-recommendation-panel.css

**Files to modify**:
- polaris-frontend/src/pages/case_view.rs — render the panel from latest LlmRecommendation observation
- polaris-frontend/src/api_client/dto.rs — RecommendationDto + RecommendedActionDto
- polaris-frontend/src/api_client/{mod,native,wasm}.rs — fetch_recommendation(case_id)

**Panel content** (per resolved Q5):
- Model + version chips
- Confidence: filled bar with translucent ghost-bar at policy.autonomous_confidence_threshold
- Recommended action(s) with policy citations linked to /policies detail pages
- LLM reasoning (Markdown rendered)
- Caveats list
- Per-mode CTAs:
  - manual: "Use as draft" pre-fills action composer
  - assisted: "Approve" / "Reject" buttons
  - autonomous already-fired: banner + "Reverse" affordance

**Rust quality**: BEM, var(--…) only, contrast passing, mobile-narrow layout

**Tests**: styles_coverage / styles_tokens / styles_contrast pass
